fields.description: Who requests/raises the change.
fields.label: Raised by

fields.description: Why the change is requested (the driver/justification).
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: Detailed description of the requested change.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: The change affects the commercial agreement. If checked, it must go through a Quotation/Addendum applied to the Project before it can be implemented.
fields.label: Commercial

fields.description: Summary of the marked impact types (for the Change Register).
fields.label: Impact summary

fields.description: Free-text notes on the impact of the change.
fields.label: Impact notes

fields.description: Non-binding estimate. The authoritative valuation lives in the Quotation.
fields.label: Hours (impact)

fields.description: Non-binding estimate. The authoritative valuation lives in the Quotation.
fields.label: Days (impact)

fields.description: Non-binding estimate. The authoritative valuation lives in the Quotation.
fields.label: Amount (impact)

fields.description: Technical/PM evaluation of the change. Multi-party discussion uses native Comments.
fields.label: Evaluation notes

fields.description: Commercial thread of the change. The commercial acceptance lives in the Quotation/Addendum workflow, not here.
fields.label: Commercial

fields.description: Logical thread (Proposal Group) of the Quotation-addendum. Preserves the version history.
fields.label: Proposal group

fields.description: Won version actually applied to the Project. Set on apply.
fields.label: Applied quotation

fields.description: Baseline in effect when the change is formalized (frozen when the change is sent to review).
fields.label: Before baseline

fields.description: Baseline that incorporates the change. Set automatically when a PMO Project Baseline of type 'Approved Change' referencing this Change Request is submitted; it is not selected manually.
fields.label: After baseline

fields.description: Set automatically on approval (Submit).
fields.label: Approved by

fields.description: Governance decision notes. Mandatory when the change is rejected: state clearly why it was rejected.
fields.label: Decision notes

fields.description: For changes without a commercial addendum: record the customer's approval. When there is a Quotation/Addendum, acceptance derives from the Won Quotation and this section does not apply.
fields.label: Customer Approval

fields.description: Whether the customer's approval is Pending, Approved, or Not Required for this change.
fields.label: Customer Approval Status

fields.description: Customer contact who approved the change.
fields.label: Customer Approved By

fields.description: Date on which the customer approved the change.
fields.label: Customer Approved On

fields.description: Reference to the customer's approval evidence (email, minutes, file, etc.). When 'Not Required', explain why the customer's approval is not needed.
fields.label: Customer Approval Notes

fields.description: Person responsible for coordinating/confirming that the approved change was incorporated into the Current Plan. Defaults to the Project's operational owner but is owned by this change and can be edited while the CR is editable. It does not modify the Project.
fields.label: Implementation Owner

fields.description: The Quotation's Scope Items were materialized as Tasks. Does not imply the Implemented state.
fields.label: Applied to Project

fields.description: Document the adjustments made, the plan updates needed, and any implementation considerations.
fields.label: Implementation notes

fields.description: What communication was done to stakeholders, or where the corresponding evidence is. Native Comments/Communication/Files remain the complementary evidence. Write 'N/A' when it genuinely does not apply. Required before closing an implemented change.
fields.label: Stakeholder Communication
